mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM doctor_ops_binding WHERE ops_id=#{ops})

SELECT d.user_id FROM doctor_ops_binding b JOIN consultation_doctor d ON d.user_id=b.doctor_user_id JOIN user_account u ON u.id=d.user_id JOIN gp_ops_identity_map m ON m.legacy_ops_id=b.ops_id JOIN sys_user s ON s.user_id=m.ruoyi_user_id WHERE b.ops_id=#{ops} AND d.status='APPROVED' AND u.is_deleted=0 AND u.account_status=1 AND s.status='0' AND s.del_flag='0'
SELECT ops_id FROM doctor_ops_binding WHERE doctor_user_id=#{user}
mapper.sql: FROM consultation_doctor d JOIN user_account u ON u.id=d.user_id LEFT JOIN doctor_ops_binding b ON b.doctor_user_id=d.user_id LEFT JOIN gp_ops_identity_map m ON m.legacy_ops_id=b.ops_id LEFT JOIN sys_user s ON s.user_id=m.ruoyi_user_id WHERE u.is_deleted=0 AND (d.status='APPROVED' OR b.ops_id IS NOT NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_wallet_entry e JOIN consultation_order o ON o.order_no=e.order_no WHERE e.user_id=#{user} AND e.amount_cents=100 AND o.doctor_user_id=#{user} AND o.status='PAID'

SELECT e.order_no,o.consultation_id,e.amount_cents,e.balance_after_cents,e.created_at FROM consultation_wallet_entry e JOIN consultation_order o ON o.order_no=e.order_no WHERE e.user_id=#{user} AND e.amount_cents=100 AND o.doctor_user_id=#{user} AND o.status='PAID' ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
